rationale: Current reporting identifies 744 Roble Road as a former Flexential data center that Flexential recently vacated and that is now offered for sale or lease. Five 9s Digital independently markets an Allentown power-ready data-center opportunity, while Flexential's current location portfolio no longer lists Allentown. The closed classification applies to the former Flexential operation, not to the physical shell or a future operator.

A property-record lead maps Comcast ownership to 14312 Northline Road near the selected footprint but describes a very small office-class improvement rather than a data center. Comcast's current local service page establishes network service in the area but does not identify this building or a data-center function. No reviewed first-party, assessor, permit, or regulatory record establishes current data-center operation at the selected footprint.

Flexential's current location portfolio identifies the Alpharetta facility and offers active services and tours, while its fleet guide maps the site to 12655 Edison Drive. The current portfolio reports a 142,475-square-foot data-center footprint and 6 MW of capacity; both facility-specific values are normalized.

Clark County's current Part 70 operating permit states that Switch owns and operates NAP 7 among six adjacent data-center facilities at 7135 South Decatur Boulevard. Switch's current Las Vegas page independently presents the Core Campus as an active data-center campus. The permit's exact NAP 7 identifier resolves the selected Switch Las Vegas 7 footprint.

New York Power Authority's 2025 ReCharge New York allocation list identifies Bloomberg L.P.'s data center at 155 Corporate Drive, matching the selected building. An Orangetown record independently identifies the same exact address as Bloomberg's data center and documents the need to keep it functioning. Together the official records establish exact identity and continuing operation.

Indiana University's current UITS contact page identifies the IU Bloomington Data Center at 2737 East 10th Street and provides active operations contacts. The current facilities page describes the building as housing IU supercomputing resources. IU's facility account reports a 90,000-square-foot building and 24-hour operation; the area is normalized as an operator-reported building value with its 2017 period.

QTS's current ATL1 DC1 data sheet maps the facility to 1033 Jefferson Street NW, matching the selected building, and publishes active services, security, and a 990,000-square-foot total facility area. QTS's 2025 compliance matrix independently lists ATL1 DC1 at the same address with current certifications. The total facility area is normalized; the separately reported data-center footprint is retained only as context.

Verizon currently advertises data-center and colocation capacity in Colorado, but its material does not identify the selected South Clinton Street footprint. A reverse-geocode result places a mobile and microwave communications tower immediately beside the selected building, which is consistent with telecommunications infrastructure but does not establish a data-center function. No reviewed operator, assessor, permit, or regulatory record maps a current Verizon data center to this exact building.
